targets.rawSql: SELECT price_date AS time, close_price, symbol FROM fact_prices JOIN dim_tickers USING (ticker_id) ORDER BY price_date
SELECT related_ticker AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM fact_news GROUP BY related_ticker ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT related_ticker AS metric, ROUND(AVG(sentiment_score)::numeric, 3) AS value FROM fact_news WHERE published_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY related_ticker
